sloka: तेन शब्देन महता सप्राकारा सतोरणा ।लङ्का प्रचलिता सर्वा सशैलवनकानना ।। ६.४१.५६ ।।।।
transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā saprākārā satoraṇā ।laṅkā pracalitā sarvā saśailavanakānanā ।। 6.41.56 ।।।।

translations.english: By the great sound the boundary, the archways and the mountains and forests shook violently.
